name: Software Development Team
purpose: Design, implement, test, and review software features and bug fixes with Clean Code rigor.

roles.title: Systems Developer
responsibilities: Write modular code and comprehensive tests

roles.title: Principal Reviewer
responsibilities: Audit code diffs for security, style, and correctness

delegation_rules: Dev submits diff and tests to Reviewer
review_process: Automated unit tests must pass 100% with zero regressions
approval_requirements: Git push to production or merge requires human approval
final_deliverable: Tested, reviewed, and verified git commit with documentation
